allowed_inputs: frame and camera metadata needed to locate the source
forbidden_inputs: HuMMan fitted mesh as a region guide

labels.POSTERIOR_TORSO_VISIBLE: visible posterior torso outer surface, including clothing
labels.NON_POSTERIOR_BODY: visible person pixels without posterior torso
labels.OCCLUDED: posterior torso expected but surface blocked/cropped/invalid

annotation_unit: per-frame 2D mask or polygon in Camera-B image coordinates; keep person-mask intersection and record depth-valid fraction
qa: Second reviewer independently labels a stratified subset; disagreements are preserved and resolved only from RGB/Depth/mask evidence. No model output may be revealed during either review.
release_gate: Only frames with POSTERIOR_TORSO_VISIBLE or explicitly documented partial visible region may enter posterior benchmark; clothing semantics remain POSTERIOR_CLOTHED_TORSO, never bare-back GT.
failure_gate: If raw Camera-B RGB/Depth/person mask cannot be located or the visible boundary cannot be independently identified, emit NOT_READY and do not score O/A/C/G.
